info.title: convoX HTTP API
info.description: Implemented first-release API. Chat operations require verified email and active cookie sessions. All public traffic requires HTTPS in production; localhost HTTP is development only. Message text is server-readable; E2EE excluded. JSON bodies are capped at 16 KiB, and payload strings at 8192 characters. Chat responses use no-store; quotas and transient failures preserve retry IDs. See realtime.md, database.md and operations.md. Staging qualification remains open.
